pages.text: The $(stellar)Sun Incarnate$() is solar fury given form - the mightiest being known to Aster Risk.$(br2)$(l)Stats:$()$(br)$(li)Health: 4000$(li)Attack/Armor: 50 $(l)+10 per enchantment$() on your gear$(li)Ignites on hit$(li)While it lives, the skies are $(l)forced clear$()$(br2)Calling it down requires forging the $(item)Sun Meteor Core$() through a four-stage ritual chain.

pages.title: The Path of the Sun
pages.text: $(l)1. Unstable Core$()$(br)$(item)Ritual Circle$() (SUN pattern): $(item)Stellar Heart$() + $(item)Eclipse Core$() + 2x $(item)Celestial Nucleus$() + 2x $(item)Enhanced Gold$() + 2x $(item)Radiant Diamond$()$(br2)$(l)2. Stable Full Moon Core$()$(br)$(item)Focus Chamber$(): Unstable Core + $(item)Prismatic Meteorite$() + $(item)Full Moon Sigil$()$(br2)$(l)3. Sun Meteor Core$()$(br)$(item)Celestial Enchanting Table$() (REVERSAL pattern)$(br2)$(l)4. Summoning$()$(br)Set the core in the $(item)Meteor Summoning Circle$() at night.

pages.title: Rules of the Sun
pages.text: $(l)Unique battle rules:$()$(br)$(li)Attacks from beyond $(l)20 blocks$() are nullified$(li)Becomes $(l)invulnerable for 1 second$() after each hit$(li)Any single blow exceeding its max health is $(l)reflected back$() at the attacker$(li)Immune to fire and explosions$(li)Touching it deals $(l)1000 damage$()$(li)Contact and reflection $(l)scorch your equipment$() - 10% max durability per hit; gear without durability is $(l)incinerated$()$(li)Everything within 20 blocks is set ablaze$(li)Liquids within 20 blocks evaporate

pages.title: Attacks & Rewards
pages.text: $(l)Attacks:$()$(br)$(li)Fireball volley$(li)Blazing melee$(li)Meteor fall$(li)Explosive blast$(li)Charging rush (destroys blocks in its path)$(li)$(l)Solar vacuum$() - drags everything nearby into it, then charges; used eagerly against foes perched 3+ blocks above$(br2)$(l)Drops:$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Radiant Diamond$()$(li)$(item)Enhanced Gold$()$(li)$(item)Celestial Nucleus$()$(li)$(item)Nether Star$()
